_comment: Ground truth for the deliberate-mispronunciation recording. This is the
closest thing this project has to labelled mispronunciation data - the
ROADMAP notes the corpus has none - so it is recorded here as a file
rather than left in a chat log.
`word_index` is the 0-based position in the whitespace-split reference
passage (client/src/passage.js, PASSAGES.fil.text), which is the same
indexing scorerInterface.js's WordResult.index uses. Every OTHER word in
the recording was read correctly, so any flag outside this list is a
Error types were chosen to be realistic pupil errors - vowel quality
swaps, l/r confusion, a dropped syllable. A wildly wrong word would be
trivially easy to catch and would flatter the results.

errors.note: the /g/ in the -ngg- cluster is dropped
l -> r, a very common Filipino reading error
o -> u in the final syllable
a -> e in the final syllable
one of the three a's is dropped
